files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 [project] kind service and entry-point main.jac; this headless slice has no npm or AI dependencies.

Define graph nodes with default-valued fields and sem strings: PersonNode(user_id, language='en', location_zip, income_bracket, family_size:int=1, preferred_contact='phone', created_at); NeedNode(category, urgency='within_weeks', details, created_at); ResourceNode(agency_name, category, capacity='open', languages_supported:list[str]=[], contact_phone, contact_email, address, online_url, description); EligibilityRuleNode(rule_id, income_limit_annual:int=0, residency_requirement='none', min_family_size:int=0, citizenship_required:bool=False, age_min:int=0, age_max:int=0, exceptions, criteria_summary, prior_success_rate:float=0.5, prior_attempts:int=0, prior_approvals:int=0); SessionInsight(session_id, ts, walkers_fired:list[str]=[], llm_calls_est:int=0, escalated, pathfinder_used, navigation_used:bool=False, eligible_count:int=0, quality_score:int=50, headline, user_prompt_snippet); FormNode(form_id, form_name, url, required_documents:list[str]=[], deadline_type='rolling', submission_method='online', estimated_minutes:int=30); ApplicationNode(application_id, status='pending', resource_name, applied_at, updated_at, denial_reason, next_step_hint, notes). String fields default to empty string.

signatures.PersonNode: node PersonNode { has user_id: str = "", language: str = "en", location_zip: str = "", income_bracket: str = "", family_size: int = 1, preferred_contact: str = "phone", created_at: str = ""; }
signatures.NeedNode: node NeedNode { has category: str = "", urgency: str = "within_weeks", details: str = "", created_at: str = ""; }
signatures.ResourceNode: node ResourceNode { has agency_name: str = "", category: str = "", capacity: str = "open", languages_supported: list[str] = [], contact_phone: str = "", contact_email: str = "", address: str = "", online_url: str = "", description: str = ""; }
signatures.ApplicationNode: node ApplicationNode { has application_id: str = "", status: str = "pending", resource_name: str = "", applied_at: str = "", updated_at: str = "", denial_reason: str = "", next_step_hint: str = "", notes: str = ""; }

files.purpose: Define typed edges with sem strings: has_need (PersonNode->NeedNode), eligible_for (NeedNode->ResourceNode), governed_by (ResourceNode->EligibilityRuleNode), requires_form (EligibilityRuleNode->FormNode), applied_to (PersonNode->ApplicationNode), reflected_on (PersonNode->SessionInsight) as empty edges, and leads_to (ResourceNode->ResourceNode) carrying transition_reason:str='', typical_days:int=30, difficulty:str='moderate'.

signatures.leads_to: edge leads_to { has transition_reason: str = "", typical_days: int = 30, difficulty: str = "moderate"; }

files.purpose: Import PersonNode, NeedNode, ApplicationNode from graph/nodes.jac and applied_to, has_need from graph/edges.jac. ImpactWalker on Root entry collects [root --> [?:PersonNode]], counts languages (default 'en'), follows ->:has_need:-> NeedNodes to count categories, and follows ->:applied_to:-> ApplicationNodes whose status != 'archived' to count total_applications, app_status_counts (pending/applied/approved/denied/withdrawn preset to 0) and per resource_name counts. approval_rate = int((approved+applied)*100/(approved+denied+applied)) or 0. Reports and stores in summary one dict with total_users, total_applications, languages (list of {lang,count}), need_categories (list of {category,count}), app_status_counts, approval_rate and top_resources (up to 5 {name,count} sorted by count descending).

signatures.ImpactWalker: walker ImpactWalker { has summary: dict = {}; can run with Root entry; }

files.purpose: Import ResourceNode, EligibilityRuleNode from graph/nodes.jac and leads_to from graph/edges.jac. PathfinderWalker on Root entry gathers seed ResourceNodes on root named in seed_resource_names plus all ResourceNodes with category == start_category, then runs a queue BFS per seed over [node ->:leads_to:-> [?:ResourceNode]] up to max_hops, recording a path once it has two hops (start, end, hops list of {from,to,reason,days,difficulty}, hop_count, total_days via module helper _sum_days) and stopping at max_paths. Paths are sorted by (total_days, hop_count). Reports and stores in summary {ok: True, start_category, max_hops, path_count, paths}.

signatures.PathfinderWalker: walker PathfinderWalker { has start_category: str = ""; has max_hops: int = 3; has max_paths: int = 3; has seed_resource_names: list[str] = []; has summary: dict = {}; can search with Root entry; }

files.purpose: Thin entry module: import ImpactWalker from walkers/impact.jac and PathfinderWalker from walkers/pathfinder.jac so both walkers are registered and importable from main.

verify.flow: seed people/needs/applications -> ImpactWalker; seed resources + leads_to chains -> PathfinderWalker
verify.steps: Run jac check main.jac and the Jac behavior tests in revdev_acceptance.jac.

assumption: Backend slice of github.com/Anbu-00001/CivicMesh (civicmesh/ project root): graph/nodes.jac, graph/edges.jac, walkers/impact.jac and walkers/pathfinder.jac used verbatim; main.jac is a new thin re-export entry. LLM, seeding-from-file and UI modules are out of scope.
